implementation_short: CloudCompare 2.14.beta (Aug 29 2026) RANSAC-SD, one OBB per plane or cylinder primitive, primitives not merged.

detection.note: Each CloudCompare RANSAC-SD primitive inlier set is one detection. Primitives were not merged into a stud. Counts are this synthetic stud, not a field accuracy.

geometry.note: Section and length are the minimal OBB of one primitive's points versus the dressed stud. A plane on one face is expected to miss the stud section.

angle.band_meaning: Percent of matched studs whose |measured - synthetic truth| is within the working tolerance.
angle.note: Truth is the generator lean against +Z. Not a SKIL reading. A face plane's long axis may still lie along the stud.

paint.production_rule: epsilon unlocked, so every stud is yellow
paint.hypothetical_placeholder_note: 0.05 deg is a round illustration of the color rule. It is not a measured device band.
paint.note: Do not read hypothetical colors as a pass/fail call.

cost.license_note: CloudCompare was executed as a separate process. Its sources were not vendored or linked.
failure_modes: A rectangular stud is not one Schnabel primitive. Planes describe faces.
A cylinder on a 2x4 is the wrong section.
Enabling both planes and cylinders can emit more than one detection for one stud.
GPL-3.0 blocks shipping a closed app linked to CloudCompare. This run does not link it.
cost.note: Runtime includes the CloudCompare process on this one stud. It is not a field budget.

notes: Synthetic stage 0 only. Not a field measurement. Device epsilon is unlocked, so production paint is yellow.
rigid_bars_note: These are the rigid dressed-stud bars. A bow fattens the section. This list is not a bow-amplitude error and not a field acceptance test.
